c74object.name: mc.ear.encode~
c74object.category: spatial audio, ADM, ambisonics, audio, mc
c74object.digest: Encode audio objects into an ambisonic scene (ADM HOA) with the spherical harmonic conventions of the EAR (ITU-R BS.2076), with multichannel signal input and output
c74object.description: Encode audio objects into an ambisonic scene (ADM HOA) with the spherical harmonic conventions of the EAR (ITU-R BS.2076), with multichannel signal input and output. Every channel of the input is an object positioned with the same messages and parameters as mc.ear.objects~; the output carries the summed ambisonic components in ACN order, (order+1)^2 channels, ready for mc.ear.hoa~ or any AmbiX decoder. Only the position (polar or cartesian) and the gain of an object affect the encoding; the other object parameters are accepted but ignored.

method.name: anything
method.digest: Any object parameter sent as a message, such as 'azimuth 30' or 'gain 0.5', is applied to all objects
method.description: Any object parameter sent as a message, such as 'azimuth 30' or 'gain 0.5', is applied to all objects.

method.name: applyvalues
method.digest: Spread values over the objects: 'applyvalues azimuth 0 90 -90' sets the azimuth of object 1 to 0, object 2 to 90 and object 3 to -90
method.description: Spread values over the objects: 'applyvalues azimuth 0 90 -90' sets the azimuth of object 1 to 0, object 2 to 90 and object 3 to -90.

method.name: chans
method.description: Set the chans attribute. Maximum number of objects (input channels). Input channels beyond this are ignored. Takes effect when the audio is restarted.

method.name: components
method.digest: Post the ambisonic components of the output channels (ACN index, order and degree) to the Max console
method.description: Post the ambisonic components of the output channels (ACN index, order and degree) to the Max console.

method.name: list
method.digest: Set the position of all objects: azimuth elevation and optional distance (polar) or x y z (cartesian)
method.description: Set the position of all objects: azimuth elevation and optional distance (polar) or x y z (cartesian).

method.name: normalization
method.description: Set the normalization attribute. Normalization of the ambisonic components: SN3D (the ADM default, also AmbiX), N3D or FuMa (up to order 3).

method.name: order
method.description: Set the order attribute. Ambisonic order of the scene, 0 to 8 (3 with FuMa normalization); can also be given as argument. The output has (order+1)^2 channels in ACN order; a new channel count takes effect when the audio is restarted.

method.name: ramp
method.description: Set the ramp attribute. Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when a position or gain changes.

method.name: setvalue
method.digest: Set a parameter of one object: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects)
method.description: Set a parameter of one object: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects). Parameters that affect the encoding: azimuth elevation distance x y z cartesian gain position; the other mc.ear.objects~ parameters are accepted but ignored.

attribute.name: chans
attribute.description: Maximum number of objects (input channels). Input channels beyond this are ignored. Takes effect when the audio is restarted. Default: 16.

attribute.name: normalization
attribute.digest: Normalization of the ambisonic components: SN3D (the ADM default, also AmbiX), N3D or FuMa (up to order 3)
attribute.description: Normalization of the ambisonic components: SN3D (the ADM default, also AmbiX), N3D or FuMa (up to order 3). Default: SN3D.

attribute.name: order
attribute.digest: Ambisonic order of the scene, 0 to 8 (3 with FuMa normalization); can also be given as argument
attribute.description: Ambisonic order of the scene, 0 to 8 (3 with FuMa normalization); can also be given as argument. The output has (order+1)^2 channels in ACN order; a new channel count takes effect when the audio is restarted. Default: 1.

attribute.name: ramp
attribute.digest: Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when a position or gain changes
attribute.description: Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when a position or gain changes. Default: 10.
